gates.evidence: The proposal targets s03 ('More memory for long chats.') and a new modal ns1; the janitor+ subscription context for 'longer memory' and 'better memory' is a standard utility surface [SAFE-1].
The reward is '30 minutes of 5x context for better memory', which is an in-app entitlement with no mention of cash, gift cards, or external rewards [POL-2 #8].
The proposal uses a sampling-effect trial ('Boost Memory for 30 Minutes') rather than a loss or hostage framing on existing content [ANTI-10].
The proposal specifies an explicit tap on the 'Play Now' (ne2) CTA before the ad plays [POL-1].
The offer body states: 'Play a quick 15-second game for 30 minutes of 5x context.' This clearly defines both the action and the duration [POL-2 #2].
The 'No Thanks' button (ne3) returns the user to the core flow (s01) with no penalty [POL-2 #5].
The trigger is m2, which occurs on paywall dismissal (s03), outside the active chat/streaming flow [ANTI-5].
Eligibility is explicitly restricted to 'Non-subscribers who dismiss the Janitor Plus paywall' [TRIG-2].

scores.evidence: The trigger (dismissing a paywall for better memory) aligns perfectly with the reward (a 30-minute trial of that exact feature). This is a strong reactive placement [TRIG-1].
The proposal preserves the flow and uses the existing 'Janitor' character as a Game Partner. It offers a sample of premium value without degrading the free experience [TAX-2].
Gating to paywall decliners at m2 is a textbook way to limit substitution [TAX-10]. The 30-minute window is significantly less than the permanent subscription benefit.
Code-computed cost to serve per view is $0.0018, which is well below the US net revenue of $0.0090–$0.0150 (approx 12-20% COGS) [TRIG-4].
The paywall (s03) is reached frequently as part of the core monetization loop, and decliners (m2) represent a large portion of the non-paying DAU [MEAS-2].
Maps to SIM-RWD with 'invitation' entry and 15s play. Requires a simple intercept on paywall dismissal, which is standard in subscription apps [POL-8].
Correctly uses nouns from the digest like 'Janitor Plus', '5x context', 'frontier models', and specific screen/element ids like s03 and e3. Identifies the exact moment m2 [TAX-10].
The proposal includes a 2 per day cap and a 120-minute cooldown, plus an explicit 'No Thanks' button [TRIG-3].
Proposes a 5% randomized user-level holdout and monitors subscription conversion as a guardrail [MEAS-5].

parsed.topConcern: Providing consistent 5x context for only 30 minutes may be technically complex to verify if the server-side memory state requires a manual toggle at expiry.
